subject.title: fix(telegram): suppress failure fallback when source delivery is message-tool-only

question: Which rebased Telegram message-tool-only fallback PR should be the canonical landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90091?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose between overlapping dirty PRs or decide whether maintainers prefer this member-authored branch or the sibling branch with stronger live proof.

options.title: Rebase one canonical guard
options.body: Pick one PR, rebase it onto current main, keep the message-tool-only guard on the skipped/failed fallback path, and close the duplicate after merge.

options.title: Prefer stronger live proof
options.body: Use the sibling PR as the canonical path if maintainers value its production Telegram proof more than this branch's simpler member-authored patch.

options.title: Request native Telegram proof
options.body: Ask for Telegram Desktop proof before landing if the source-level and unit-test evidence is not enough for visible chat behavior.

recommendation.title: Rebase one canonical guard
recommendation.body: Pick one PR, rebase it onto current main, keep the message-tool-only guard on the skipped/failed fallback path, and close the duplicate after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram dispatcher commits cover the adjacent fallback and progress-delivery behavior that this PR touches.
